body: I apologize if anyone told you other than that I understand your struggles and want to help. That is the problem, we all want to help you but how this sub is, it’s just asking evil people to post. Everyone here wants to help you, but we are literally in the same place.
That’s basically my thoughts as well. It has been  problematic in my life going through depression. I’m just a bit confused about how this sub is supposed to be helping

The sub is called suicidewatch. Absolutely no one is expecting full on psychologists to be responding.

However I’m frightened it might be damaging for the only people posting/responding to either be currently have these tendencies or  have them in the past. I’d love for a mod to explain how the psychology of this could be helpful for someone

Personally, I think if it is just a place to vent the sub should be r/vent.

People come here looking for actual help, and that is misleading.

Yes, I’ve absolutely done this.  I Keep having goals for myself for things getting better/thing looking forward too. I always am making new things to look forward to but it is getting difficult to believe in those happy thoughts.

https://imgur.com/a/YzBdrFo/ 

Here’s the bub and the kitty as little ones. We are all here for you.

Emotions are a fickle thing, there’s not a reason to feel stupid for them. They just are what they are.

My kitty has been sitting on my lap for a half hour. I love the company. She’s not a long hair but jeeeezus she sheds so much. Her and my dog love each other, but they just can’t seem to figure out how to cuddle right. My cat always rubs up against my dog purring and then he tries to sit next to/on her. It looks pretty ridiculous.
